questions.question: What is the climactic statement of Psalm 111?
options: The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
The steadfast love of the LORD endures forever
The works of the LORD are great and marvelous
questions.answer: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom

questions.question: How does the psalmist describe God's works?
options: Few and hidden from the wise; made known only to the lowly and humble
Brief, passing quickly like the dew; gone away with the very early morning
Harsh, greatly feared by the nations; dreaded by all of the proud
Great, studied by all who delight in them; full of splendor and majesty
questions.answer: Great, studied by all who delight in them; full of splendor and majesty

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD is gracious and merciful and provides food for those who fear him.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of _____.
The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his _____ are trustworthy.
